title: StegSeed Definition
description: Defines a potential entity whose instantiation is governed by admissibility rules under the StegSeed model.

seed_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this seed definition (immutable across versions).

version.description: Version of the definition. New versions must not alter prior admissibility semantics retroactively.

entity_type.description: Domain classification (e.g., physical_part, ai_capability, role_definition, temporal_action, compliance_claim).

definition_hash.description: Content hash of the immutable definition payload (design, spec, code, or plan).

description.description: Human-readable summary of the entity being defined.

admissibility.description: Structured rules that must be satisfied for instantiation.

conditions.description: List of admissibility predicates expressed in the StegSeed Conditions DSL.

conflict_group.description: Optional identifier for mutual exclusivity with other seeds.

max_instances.description: Optional cap on the number of valid instantiations allowed.

evidence_obligations.description: Artifacts that must exist in the witness bundle at substantiation time.

type.description: Category of required evidence (e.g., inspection_report, signature, measurement_scan, certification).

scope.description: What the evidence must apply to (entity, actor, environment, system_state).

min_count.description: Minimum number of such artifacts required.

lifecycle_rules.description: Optional constraints governing how instances may be superseded, revoked, or retired.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this definition was published.

created_by.description: Identifier of the publishing authority or system.

signature.description: Digital signature attesting to the integrity and authorship of this definition.
